"Don't Fly Without This App" WSJ • Finalist for App of The Year • Winner of Apple Design Award

The flight tracker your pilot uses.

Free trial does not required credit card.
No account required.
No newsletters.
No ads.

▶ WORLD'S FASTEST DELAY ALERTS
- 2-90 minutes faster than airline apps

▶ PILOT-GRADE DATA
- Live-streaming
- Actual flight plans

- Tail number – with birthday, type, and even name
- Full flight timetable
- Proximity radar - see flights around you

▶ BE THE FIRST TO KNOW
- Late arriving aircraft delays – up to 6 hours before your airline!

- Delay forecast

▶ ASSISTANTS
- Morning-Of Assistant - wake up informed
- Check In Assistant - your reservation number and check in link at the right time
- Connection Assistant - see all the checkpoints required for your connection and how long it typically takes
- Import Assistant - seamless import (plus data enrichment!) from myFlightradar24, App In The Air, OpenFlights.org, FlightMemory, Logmyflight, and JetLovers

▶ WORLDWIDE + LIVE + UNLIMITED
- Every airline
- Every flight
- 24/7/365 live global coverage

▶ FLIGHTY FRIENDS
- Often sharing with Family and Friends? Invite them to see your flights and never manually share again!
- Picking someone up, excited for a friend to visit, meeting a colleague? Share your live flight status with one tap.

▶ WHAT'S FREE?

▶ WHAT'S PRO?
- See why your flight is delayed
- Pilot-grade FAA delay alerts
- Delay predictions, including the reason why
- Industry's fastest push alerts
- 25-hour where's my plane
- Live lock screen widgets

- Delay predictions

Pro is free on your first flight. No trial required.

results.releaseNotes:
INTRODUCING CONNECTION ASSISTANT 2

Flighty now shows exactly what it takes to make your connection, with a personalized step-by-step guide for any airline, at airports worldwide.

# Required Checkpoints
See every checkpoint required for your exact connection, including passport control, customs, baggage re-check, security, air trains, terminal changes, and more. Flighty builds the guide based on your route, airport, nationality, and booking details.

# Typical Connection Time
See how long each step typically takes, so you know whether your connection is comfortable, close, or seriously tight. Times are based on historical patterns and normal conditions.

# Gate Predictions
Flighty can now predict arrival and departure gates before airlines assign them, based on prior flights and your inbound plane. Predictions may start as a concourse or gate range, then sharpen as departure gets closer.

# Personalized To You
Add your seat, class and passport to see even more tailored instructions, including e-gates, and citizenship-specific steps.

# Friends’ Connections
Connection Assistant also works with Flighty Friends, so you can see how tight a friend’s connection is, too.

Connection Assistant is available for Flighty Pro users.
